```{r load_q4_data, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source("Q4.R")
```

```{r analyze_mode, echo=FALSE}
summary_statistics <- summary(model)
```

The linear model $$
\hat{general\_votes} = \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_0{ttl\_disb} + \hat{\beta}_2I({candidate\_party}){ttl\_disb}
$$ shows statistically significant estimators for democrats and other parties, but not republicans.

The following plot shows that the data is likely linear in nature, though heteroskedastic.

```{r plot_1}
plot(model, which = 1)
```

The following ploat shows that the our model is unbiased and is normally-distributed.

```{r plot_2}
plot(model, which = 2)
```
